capabilities: Insert new lines above the current line when Enter is pressed
Toggle reverse mode on or off per note
Reverse all lines of text in the current note
extras: Reverse mode can be turned on or off on a note-by-note basis rather than applying to the whole vault by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write or arrange text bottom-to-top, since Enter always inserts lines below the cursor.
summary: Editing-mode plugin that makes Enter insert a new line above the current one and can reverse the line order of a note.
